notes.tagline: A smaller, content-led player. Real subdomain architecture, a credible library, and an honest practitioner page — but only 4.8K visits / mo and 70% of it is brand. The non-brand library and locations are the only real organic engine.

visual_system: Pastel green + cream palette — calm, professional, modern Webflow build.
Photography mixes patients, clinicians and lifestyle — closer to wellness than retail.
Generous whitespace, rounded cards, large display type.
Patient portal and shop on dedicated subdomains (patient., shop.) — proper SaaS-style separation.
site_architecture: /library — ~16 long-form editorial posts; the most credible content on the site.
/practitioners — named clinicians with bios — strong E-E-A-T signal that most competitors skip.
/faqs and /location-faqs — heavy informational coverage targeting long-tail questions.
tone_compliance: Compliant clinical language — consultations, eligibility, treatment plans.
Library posts use plain-English explainers; cites TGA framework correctly.
Names individual prescribers on /practitioners — rare in this category.
No specific-condition claims on commercial pages.

eeat.notes: Polln is the cleanest of the small-cap competitors on E-E-A-T: real named practitioners, dated library posts, plain-English clinical copy. Schema coverage is partial — Organization and Person are present, MedicalCondition / MedicalWebPage are not. Library cadence has slowed.

steal.note: Patient portal earns 637 visits / mo on 6 keywords — defensive brand+navigational traffic that compounds. Cheap separation that signals scale.
/practitioners/dr-joel-wren earns 25 visits / mo just on name search. Strongest E-E-A-T signal in the deck. Replicable in a week with our roster.

steal.play: Long-form library posts on category questions
steal.note: 5 library posts produce 100+ visits each — sativa-vs-indica, vaping guide, how-long-does-cannabis-stay. Educational, evergreen, citable. Highest organic ROI on the site.
11 city pages, each paired with a location-FAQ page targeting 'authorised prescribers [state]'. Beats Herbly's storefront template on intent depth.
Their library out-ranks larger competitors on educational queries because the copy is patient-facing, not pharma-facing. Match the tone.

avoid.evidence: 16 library posts is the entire editorial inventory. Cadence has dropped — recent dates are sparse. The asset that works is starving for fresh entries.
11 city pages with only 2 ranking meaningfully (Perth, Adelaide ~54 visits each). Templated but not deep enough to defend.
70% of traffic is brand — 2,320 visits on 'polln' alone. Outside the brand fortress, the organic engine is small.
Hundreds of keywords ranking #21–100 producing near-zero traffic. The site has reach but not depth on most queries.

implications: Polln is the credibility template — named clinicians, library, FAQs done right.
The library is small and slowing — they cannot out-publish a serious content programme.
Locations and 'near me' are still wide open at suburb level.
Out-author them on the same topics — they prove demand, we win SERPs with depth + cadence.

gap_matrix.comment: Open. They publish thin condition pages.
11 city pages — easy to out-template at suburb level.
Steal the format. Out-publish on cadence.
